ticks.note: `empty`: `Draining` → `Rinse`, which enters `Refilling` in the same tick. Three states are active: `Programme`, `Rinse` and `Refilling`.

`empty`: `Emptying` → `Rinsed`, so `Rinse` terminates and its `join to Done` fires; `Done` is final, so `Programme` terminates too and its join fires. All of it in this one tick: `beep` is present and the machine is in `Idle`.
